name: Use After Free
essence: Playback reads an alias after the audio frame has been transferred and throws.

examples.summary: Playback reads an alias after the audio frame has been transferred and throws.
examples.mechanism: Transferring detaches the ArrayBuffer; constructing a DataView through the remaining alias traps access to the detached ArrayBuffer.
examples.observed_output:
playback detached true
TypeError: Cannot perform DataView constructor on a detached ArrayBuffer
examples.expected_behavior: Read the sample before transfer or use the transferred buffer.

ingredients.suggests: Playback and frame name the same mutable buffer.
Playback is still used after transfer invalidates the original buffer.

examples.summary: A ctypes alias outlives its unmapped frame storage and reads a released address, terminating the subprocess..
examples.mechanism: A ctypes alias outlives its unmapped frame storage and reads a released address, terminating the subprocess.
examples.expected_behavior: Read sample 23 while the mapping is still owned.

ingredients.suggests: Playback aliases storage owned by the mapped frame.
A ctypes alias is read after the underlying mapping is released.

examples.summary: Playback dereferences memory after its mapping has been released.
examples.mechanism: unsafe retains a pointer into a syscall.Mmap allocation after syscall.Munmap; the invalid dereference is trapped by the runtime.
examples.observed_output: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
examples.expected_behavior: Read the sample before unmapping, or invalidate all aliases.

ingredients.suggests: Playback aliases the same page bytes owned by the mapping.
The saved pointer is dereferenced after Munmap releases the page.

examples.summary: Playback reads an unmapped audio allocation and terminates.
examples.mechanism: unsafe raw pointers bypass allocation lifetime checks. POSIX mmap/munmap releases the page before playback reads its alias; this standalone example targets macOS and Linux.
examples.expected_behavior: The frame remains owned until playback finishes.

ingredients.suggests: Playback and frame alias the same raw allocation.
Playback retains and reads the raw pointer after munmap releases the allocation.
